title: Zero feedback coverage in drift window

title: Drift window start and end timestamps identical
detail: window_start_ts equals window_end_ts, indicating the drift window has not advanced. This may signal a stalled or misconfigured drift tracking mechanism.
suggestion: Investigate drift window update logic to ensure timestamps progress correctly.

title: LLM has made zero calls since startup
detail: With 47 frames processed and an urban scene with high pedestrian activity, no LLM calls have been made. This may indicate LLM invocation thresholds are not being met or the module is inactive.

title: Ego speed proxy unavailable
detail: speed_proxy_mps is null, meaning vehicle speed cannot be estimated. This limits risk scoring accuracy, especially in an active urban scene.
suggestion: Check ego speed estimation source; ensure vehicle telemetry or optical flow is feeding the proxy.
